templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard MNDA template enabling parties to share sensitive information securely. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page template for the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Includes signature blocks and key terms customization fields.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive services agreement covering service delivery, intellectual property, privacy, payments, termination, warranties, liability limits, and indemnification for professional service engagements.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Covers service access, usage rights, privacy, security, payment, term, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum template addressing AI-specific provisions including AI service usage, input/output ownership, model training restrictions, intellectual property, and AI-generated content disclaimers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant agreement establishing obligations between a Provider and Company regarding Protected Health Information (PHI) handling, privacy safeguards, breach notification, and compliance requirements.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-compliant data processing agreement covering processor/subprocessor relationships, data processing details, restricted transfers, security incident response, audit rights, and data deletion procedures.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early product access and design partnership. Governs feedback ownership, product improvement rights, confidentiality, intellectual property, and program termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term contract for prospective customers to test a product or service before committing to longer-term deals. Includes usage rights, term flexibility, and evaluation provisions.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for strategic partnerships covering cooperation, payment, trademark licensing, privacy, escalation procedures, termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Agreement defining service performance metrics including target uptime, response time commitments, service credits, and remedies for performance failures.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive agreement for software licensing covering installation, usage rights, user accounts, feedback, machine learning usage, updates, payment, termination, warranties, liability, and indemnification.
